comments.body:
I think it will be very difficult. Currently, the job market is very difficult. I have friends with engineering masters from Ethz which struggle to find a job currently. If you come with only a bachelor (from eth, from FH its a different story) you are for sure second choice anyway.

I have a master from Mavt as well and I also thought about quiting after my bachelor, to do something completly different.

If you are sick of studying, I would recommand you to do an internship for 6 months. Or even a year. You need it anyway for the master. If you are lucky, they offer you a job afterwards. But after 6 months in industry, Im almost sure you will be motivated to go back to study again.

In general, I would highly recommand to do the master. Its way easier than the bachelor! So much less stress! If you find a good company, you can do your semester thesis and the master thesis at the company, which feels then kind of regular work.

If you are in industry, you will see that many projects and a lot of the work is quite retarted. Having a master gives you a good reason to argue why you should be given the interesting work and why you should be in charge to make the technical desicions.

I did not regret making the master.
comments.author: DifferentFroyo1872
